issues.issue: Mixed line. The county treasurer schedule (p12) shows motor vehicle taxes 23,374, motor vehicle prorate 729, homestead exemption 18,484, property tax relief 11,890, carline 623 and in-lieu 30 passing to the village, and these are probably inside State shared revenue. They don't reconcile exactly, so leaving it unsplit is correct, but the line has no review note naming the mix (rule: a line combining several such sources stays state aid with a review note). The same applies to the per-fund detail lines.

The Statement of Activities (p2) counts this with Federal 85,515 as Capital Grants and Contributions (444,207; public works 319,191). No grantor is printed, so other/Grants follows existing decisions, but it could be intergovernmental. This is a judgment call.
Inconsistent with 'State tax receivable' 26,360 (assets[5]), which is due from other governments. Sales tax is remitted by the state, so it could also be due from other governments.
